title: K-Silverfox Structure Pack Solo #08 (한국 · 폴카도트·물결 · 체형 wide hip narrow)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean silver fox goddess luminous milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and smooth dewy skin elegant silver-era maturity, early 40s, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white vintage victory rolls framing the face — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 3 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 23% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 73% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 20% of the way down her figure from the top and about 20% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING GLOSSY JET BLACK scale formations, VIVID DEEP PURPLE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the round patch centred about 33% of the way down her figure from the top and about 55% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Where a patch meets the background, the two materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the edge of every patch is made only of the patch's material and the background material, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Face: a real photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration and not a CG render — visible pores and fine skin grain, the fine natural expression lines of her age around the eyes and mouth, faint peach-fuzz hairs catching the light, natural tonal variation with a soft flush on the cheeks, a few small natural beauty marks, slight natural asymmetry, eyes with real wet catchlights and individual lashes, lips with real vertical texture — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
